text:
sophia: quick ask — I'm trying to reproduce the session-token-rotation bug in staging. Can I enable a short-lived request/response dump for the failing service? need to see full request bodies for a few reproductions (there will be user emails, maybe phone numbers).
chris: would prefer not to log raw emails or tokens. if you need identifiers for correlation, hash them with an HMAC keyed by a KMS key and redact Authorization/Cookie headers.
sophia: ok — for the headers are we ok to capture status + path + user-agent? or should we strip everything except path and status?
security-bot: Reminder: logging policy requires PII to be pseudonymized or minimized. See https://redwood.internal/policies/logging-redaction (read-only). Any temporary capture must include retention window, approved list of viewers, and an audit log.
julian: please create a ticket with scope, retention, and who needs access. my expectation: HMAC emails, remove token strings, redact `Authorization` and `Set-Cookie` entirely. path + status + user-agent is OK for debugging.
sophia: creating ticket INFR-4321 now — retention requested 7 days, devs @chris and @sophia only, reason: reproduce token rotation failure. will use KMS key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/debug/cryptoKeys/tmp-logs` for HMAC.
chris: sample HMAC snippet for reference:
```
# python example
import hmac, hashlib, base64
KEY = b"<kms-decrypted-key-bytes>"
def hmac_email(email):
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hmac.new(KEY, email.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()).decode()[:16]
```
sophia: thanks — we'll implement that and redact tokens. question: can ops enable ephemeral capture via the feature flag or do we need a dedicated job?
ops-oncall: we can flip a capture flag per service; config example (yaml):
```
capture:
  enabled: true
  expires_at: "2026-03-25T12:00:00Z"
  redact_headers: ["Authorization","Set-Cookie"]
  pseudonymize_fields: ["user.email","user.phone"]
```
ops-oncall: enable requires an approval comment on INFR-4321, and we'll add ephemeral S3 path with 7d lifecycle.
julian: ok I will review INFR-4321, need explicit list of viewers + justification. If everything matches: approve with condition that we rotate the KMS key after capture and that access is audited.
sophia: added viewers: chris, sophia. justification in ticket. will post back here when capture is enabled.
chris: also please ensure the dump masks any `prompt` fields from LLM calls (we've seen user-provided prompts contain emails). mask them with `<REDACTED_PROMPT>`.
julian: approve the capture under the conditions discussed (HMAC, redact tokens, mask prompts, 7d retention, auditors: security + infra). I approve on ticket INFR-4321 — please CC infra-priv when you enable.
sophia: thanks all — enabling patch will include the hmac function, header redaction, prompt mask, and expiration. will ping when live :thumbsup:
chris: great — once enabled I'll run the repro and attach minimal sanitized traces to the ticket.
security-bot: Note: automated audit entry created for INFR-4321 when julian approved.
sophia: capture enabled now and will auto-expire on 2026-03-25T12:00:00Z. notifying infra-priv for access grant.
julian: confirmed, I see the audit entry. leaving final note: remove any retained copies after the retention window and confirm closure on INFR-4321. :eyes:
